description: itch.io Help Wanted or Offered (deals): search_postings. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

tools.name: search_postings
tools.description: The feed answers its whole current list in one response (the board's RSS 2.0 feed, latest ~50 topics); query, category, min_budget, page and limit are not sent (the feed documents no parameters) — filter the returned postings client-side and ignore next_page (page 2 is the same list). Topics are both offers and requests for help (often '[PAID]', '[REVSHARE]' or '[Hobby]' in the title); description is HTML; createDate/updateDate are in raw.
